metadata.title: Top 50 Homeopathic Remedies Reference Guide
metadata.description: Structured quick reference for key indications, modalities, and remedy relationships for vector database ingestion.
metadata.disclaimer: This dataset is provided for educational and informational purposes only. It is not intended as medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Homeopathic remedies are not substitutes for evidence-based medical care, standard clinical practice, or emergency medical treatment. Always consult a licensed healthcare professional or physician for medical conditions, serious symptoms, or health concerns.

complementary_pairs.note: Trauma sequence: Arnica for soft tissue bruising/shock, followed by Rhus Tox for joint/tendon stiffness or Hypericum for nerve injury.
The Croup Trio: Aconite initially for sudden dry fever, Spongia for barking cough, Hepar Sulph for loose/purulent stage.
Calcarea Carbonica acts as the chronic complement to acute Belladonna complaints.
Acute-to-chronic dynamic for rheumatic/joint pains (Bryonia worse by motion; Rhus Tox relieved by motion).
Silicea acts as the deep, chronic complement to acute Pulsatilla conditions.
Complementary in allergic rhinitis and upper respiratory tract infections spreading downward.
Ignatia for acute grief/shock; Natrum Mur as its chronic complement for suppressed sorrow.

incompatible_pairs.reason: Apis aggravated by heat and relieved by cold; Rhus Tox aggravated by cold/damp and relieved by heat. They act antidotally on each other.
Opposing constitutional spheres of action; can neutralize each other's therapeutic efficacy.
Deep, conflicting actions on suppurative (pus-forming) tissue processes.
Caution advised when administering Sulphur immediately following Calcarea Carbonica without an intervening remedy.

remedies.name: Aconitum Napellus
key_indications: Sudden onset of acute symptoms
High fever with dry, hot skin
Intense anxiety, restlessness, and acute fear of death
Ailments from sudden exposure to cold, dry winds

remedies.name: Aesculus Hippocastanum
key_indications: Hemorrhoids feeling like sharp sticks or dry needles
Low back pain radiating to hips and sacrum
Dryness and warmth in rectum with fullness

remedies.name: Allium Cepa
key_indications: Profuse, acrid, burning nasal discharge corroding upper lip
Bland, watery tearing from eyes
Frequent, violent sneezing
Tickling in larynx causing painful cough

remedies.name: Anacardium Orientale
key_indications: Sensation of a plug or band in various body parts
Dual personality feeling or internal conflict
Sudden loss of memory when stressed
Symptoms temporarily relieved while eating

remedies.name: Antimonium Tartaricum
key_indications: Excessive rattling cough with chest full of mucus
Inability or weakness to expectorate phlegm
Drowsiness, weakness, and cold sweat during respiratory distress
Nausea with white coated tongue

remedies.name: Apis Mellifica
key_indications: Stinging, burning pain with marked localized edema or swelling
Absence of thirst during fever or inflammation
Intolerance to heat in any form
Restlessness and clumsiness (dropping objects)

remedies.name: Argentum Nitricum
key_indications: Anticipatory anxiety and stage fright
Nervous diarrhea before events or exams
Craving for sweets which aggravate stomach
Sensation of a splinter in throat on swallowing

remedies.name: Arnica Montana
key_indications: Blunt trauma, bruises, hematomas, and sprains
Sore, bruised feeling all over the body
Refusal of medical aid ('I am fine' attitude despite injury)
Bed feels too hard

remedies.name: Arsenicum Album
key_indications: Burning pains relieved by external heat
Extreme restlessness alongside profound physical weakness
High anxiety regarding health, order, and cleanliness
Gastroenteritis/food poisoning with simultaneous vomiting and diarrhea

remedies.name: Baptisia Tinctoria
key_indications: High fever with rapid prostration and muscular soreness
All excretions (breath, sweat, stool) are offensive
Delirium with sensation of body being scattered or broken into pieces
Dull, dusky red face

remedies.name: Baryta Carbonica
key_indications: Swollen tonsils with tendency to suppuration/quinsy
Enlargement and hardening of cervical and glandular tissues
Developmental delays, shyness, or lack of confidence in children
Physical and mental decline or memory loss in elderly

remedies.name: Belladonna
key_indications: Sudden, violent onset of high fever and inflammation
Throbbing headache with flushed red face and radiant heat
Dilated pupils and glassy eyes
Dry mouth and throat with lack of thirst or desire for cold water only

remedies.name: Bryonia Alba
key_indications: Excessive dryness of all mucous membranes with extreme thirst
Severe stitching pain made worse by the slightest motion
Irritability and anxiety about business or money matters
Dry, painful cough holding the chest during cough

remedies.name: Calcarea Carbonica
key_indications: Chilly constitution with cold, damp feet
Profuse sweating, especially around head and neck during sleep
Slow metabolism, weight gain, and sluggish thyroid function
Craving for eggs and indigestible items (chalk, soil)

incompatible: Sulphur (when given immediately before/after without intermediate remedy)

remedies.name: Calcarea Phosphorica
key_indications: Slow bone healing after fractures and late dentition in infants
Chronic dissatisfaction and strong desire to travel or change places
Bone, joint, and muscular pains in rapidly growing children
Abdominal cramps in school-aged children

remedies.name: Calendula Officinalis
key_indications: Open wounds, lacerations, burns, and surgical incisions
Promotes healthy granulation tissue and prevents infection/suppuration
Pain out of proportion to injury size
Ruptured muscles or tendons

remedies.name: Cantharis
key_indications: Severe burning, cutting UTI or cystitis with constant desire to urinate
Passage of urine drop-by-drop with severe tenesmus
Scalds and thermal burns with rapid blister formation
Extreme irritability and restlessness during pain

remedies.name: Carbo Vegetabilis
key_indications: Severe abdominal bloating and flatulence with upper GI distress
Air-hunger requiring air to be fanned directly at face
Extreme physical collapse, weakness, and cold skin/extremities
Sluggish venous circulation

remedies.name: Causticum
key_indications: Progressive muscular weakness, stiffness, or local paralyses
Chronic hoarseness or loss of voice in singers and speakers
Involuntary leakage of urine when coughing, sneezing, or laughing
Intense sympathy for the suffering of others

remedies.name: Chamomilla
key_indications: Extreme irritability, impatience, and violent anger from pain
Hypersensitivity to pain ('unbearable pain')
Teething infants who demand to be carried constantly
One cheek red and hot, the other pale and cold

remedies.name: China Officinalis
key_indications: Extreme debility and weakness from loss of vital fluids (blood, sweat, diarrhea)
Abdominal flatulence with bloating not relieved by belching
Hypersensitivity to light touch, while firm pressure relieves
Periodic fevers or neuralgias

remedies.name: Cicuta Virosa
key_indications: Severe convulsions, spasms, and twitching
Opisthotonos (spine arching backward rigid body position)
Head injuries or spinal irritation triggering neurological symptoms
Desire to eat strange non-food items (chalk, raw turnips)

remedies.name: Cimicifuga / Actaea Racemosa
key_indications: Hormonal imbalances, severe dysmenorrhea, and labor pains
Mental state: feeling covered by a heavy black cloud or impending doom
Stiffness and neuralgic pain in neck, upper back, and spine
Infra-mammary pains on left side

remedies.name: Cina
key_indications: Intestinal worm symptoms: constant picking or boring at nose
Grinding of teeth during sleep
Extreme irritability, tantrums, and touch aversion in children
Dark circles around eyes with variable appetite

remedies.name: Cocculus Indicus
key_indications: Motion sickness, sea-sickness, and nausea from traveling
Extreme dizziness and weakness due to loss of sleep or caregiving ('night-watching')
Hollow or empty sensation in head and abdomen
Slow reflexes and difficulty concentrating

remedies.name: Coffea Cruda
key_indications: Insomnia due to mental hyperactivity, rapid flow of ideas, or pleasant excitement
Hypersensitivity to pain, touch, sound, and smell
Toothache relieved temporarily by ice water in mouth
Nervous palpitations with excitement

remedies.name: Colchicum Autumnale
key_indications: Extreme intolerance to the smell of cooking food (causes severe nausea/fainting)
Gouty inflammation of joints, especially the big toe
Abdominal distension with cold sensation in stomach
Joint pains shifting rapidly

remedies.name: Colocynthis
key_indications: Sharp, agonized cramping abdominal or intestinal pain
Pain forces patient to bend double or press hard against objects
Ailments and stomach colic triggered by anger, indignation, or offense
Sciatica with shooting pains down left leg

remedies.name: Conium Maculatum
key_indications: Vertigo triggered by turning head or eyes, or lying down in bed
Progressive ascending muscular weakness and paralysis
Induration and stony hardening of glands (breast, prostate, lymph nodes)
Ailments from celibacy or suppressed sexual desire

remedies.name: Drosera Rotundifolia
key_indications: Paroxysmal, barking, dry, spasmodic cough
Cough triggers retching, choking, or vomiting of mucus
Tickling sensation in larynx like a feather
Hoarseness with deep, hollow voice

remedies.name: Dulcamara
key_indications: Ailments triggered by sudden change in weather from hot to cold/damp
Catarrhal colds, joint pains, or skin eruptions in autumn
Diarrhea or respiratory issues in damp weather
Urticaria or skin rashes with cold exposure

remedies.name: Eupatorium Perfoliatum
key_indications: Intense bone pain ('as if bones were broken') accompanying fevers/flu
Severe muscle aching, soreness, and restlessness with fever
Thirst for cold water before and during chill
Painful eyeballs and frontal headache

remedies.name: Euphrasia Officinalis
key_indications: Profuse, acrid, burning eye discharge (lacrimation)
Bland, non-irritating, watery nasal discharge
Frequent blinking and photophobia (light sensitivity)
Cough only during daytime, relieved by lying down

remedies.name: Gelsemium Sempervirens
key_indications: Heavy eyelids (ptosis), extreme lethargy, and motor weakness
Trembling of limbs from weakness or emotional fright
Dull, heavy headache starting in neck/occiput extending to forehead
Performance anxiety, stage fright, or bad news reactions

remedies.name: Graphites
key_indications: Thick, sticky, honey-like oozing fluid from eczema and skin cracks
Cracks/fissures behind ears, corners of mouth, and fingertips
Chronic constipation with large stool covered in mucus
Chilly constitution with tendency to obesity and skin induration

remedies.name: Hepar Sulphuris Calcareum
key_indications: Extreme hyper-sensitivity to cold air, drafts, and physical touch
Sharp, splinter-like pains in inflamed tissues or throat
Strong tendency to rapid suppuration and pus formation
Irritable personality with violent impulses when crossed

incompatible: Silicea (when used unmanaged in high potency immediately before)

remedies.name: Hypericum Perforatum
key_indications: Injuries to nerve-rich areas (fingertips, toes, spine, coccyx)
Sharp, shooting, radiating pains traveling upward along nerves
Crushed or lacerated extremities with nerve involvement
Phantom limb pain after amputation

remedies.name: Ignatia Amara
key_indications: Acute grief, heartbreak, emotional shock, and silent sorrow
Rapid, paradoxical mood swings and involuntary deep sighing
Sensation of a lump in throat (globus hystericus)
Paradoxical symptoms (e.g., sore throat relieved by swallowing solids)

remedies.name: Ipecacuanha
key_indications: Persistent, relentless nausea not relieved by vomiting
Clean, un-coated tongue despite severe GI distress
Excessive salivation during nausea
Spasmodic cough with suffocation, gasping, and wheezing

remedies.name: Kali Bichromicum
key_indications: Thick, stringy, tough, yellow-green mucous discharges from any membrane
Sinus headache and pressure localized in tiny, spot-like areas
Deep, punched-out ulcers on mucous membranes or skin
Pain shifting rapidly from joint to joint

remedies.name: Lachesis Muta
key_indications: Symptoms start on left side and move to right side
Extreme intolerance to tight clothing around neck, throat, or waist
Loquacity (excessive talking), suspicion, and jealousy
Symptoms worsen significantly after sleep ('sleeps into aggravation')

remedies.name: Lycopodium Clavatum
key_indications: Symptoms start on right side and move to left side
Excessive abdominal gas and bloating shortly after eating small amounts
Performance anxiety masking underlying dictatorial/bossy behavior
Craving for warm drinks and sweets

remedies.name: Mercurius Solubilis
key_indications: Profuse, oily, foul-smelling night sweats that do not relieve fever
Excessive salivation at night wetting pillow; metallic mouth taste
Flabby, swollen tongue with indentation of teeth on edges
Extremely sensitive to both heat and cold temperatures ('thermometer')

remedies.name: Natrum Muriaticum
key_indications: Reserved, introverted temperament holding onto past grief/rejection
Craving for salt and aversion to bread or slimy foods
Deep vertical crack in center of lower lip; cold sores on lips
Throbbing headache 'like little hammers beating inside skull'

remedies.name: Nux Vomica
key_indications: Ambitious, competitive, irritable, and impatient personality
Digestive trouble from overeating, alcohol, coffee, and sedentary lifestyle
Frequent, ineffective urging for stool or urination
Extreme chilly disposition; cannot get warm even in bed

remedies.name: Phosphorus
key_indications: Extroverted, sympathetic, impressionable, but easily exhausted
Craving for ice-cold drinks (vomited as soon as warmed in stomach)
Burning sensations in palms, spine, chest, or stomach
Tendency to easy bleeding from small cuts or mucous membranes

remedies.name: Pulsatilla Nigricans
key_indications: Changeable physical symptoms and wandering joint pains
Mild, gentle, weeping disposition seeking consolation and affection
Complete thirstlessness even during high fever
Thick, bland, yellow-green mucous discharges

remedies.name: Rhus Toxicodendron
key_indications: Joint and muscle stiffness following the 'rusty hinge' concept
Severe stiffness on initial motion, which gradually eases with continued movement
Extreme physical restlessness; forced to change positions constantly
Red triangular tip on tongue

remedies.name: Silicea
key_indications: Lack of vital heat; chilly constitution needing warm head wrapping
Promotes expulsion of foreign bodies (splinters, needles, thorn)
Profuse, offensive, sour foot sweat
Yielding disposition with underlying obstinacy ('grit')

remedies.name: Sulphur
key_indications: Burning sensations (soles of feet, top of head, skin, eyes)
Sticks feet out of bed at night due to burning heat
Messy, unkempt appearance; dislike of bathing or water
Redness of all bodily orifices (lips, eyelids, anus)

incompatible: Calcarea Carbonica (if given immediately after Calcarea)
